【原视频简介】
Have you ever asked yourself why is Minecraft getting slower over the years, why is it getting harder to run while not changing that much? In this video I will go in depth on why i think modern world generation being data driven and overengineered is not a good thing, and what the actual cost of having this configurable from the outside is.

0:00 Intro
0:31 Modern World Generation Design Goals
1:03 Data Driven Design Issues
4:47 The Modern Game's Fundamentals are Still like 2012
6:18 Datapacks Have a Cost
7:50 World Generation is Still Similar to 2010
10:45 Abstractions Have a Cost
11:23 Old Minecraft is Not Perfect Either
12:09 JSON Modding Alternatives
13:27 The Modern Game is Still Entangled
14:32 Conclusion
